title: Getting started
intro: Cheese has an AI teammate. Hand it a piece of work and it shows you a plan before it starts, then gives the result to you to review. Let's take a minute to get you set up.

role.q: What do you mainly use Cheese for?
role.why: Your AI teammate uses this to suggest a first task and to know who it is working with.

task.q: What would you like to get done first?
task.why: Pick one, or write your own. It becomes your first project.
task.files: Drop the files you will need here, or click to choose (optional)
task.filesNote: The files go to your AI teammate with your first task.
task.ownPlan: Show me a plan first, and start once I confirm.
task.ownPlaceholder: For example: turn this term's lecture notes into a revision outline

report.label: Write a course report or paper draft
report.hint: Outline first, then the full text
report.name: Course report
report.text: Write a course report for me. Show me the outline first, and write it in full once I confirm. The topic and requirements are:

project.label: Build a course project
project.name: Course project
project.text: Build a course project for me and give me a preview I can open when it is done. Show me how you plan to do it first, and start once I confirm. What I need to build is:

review.label: Make revision notes
review.hint: Slides and notes into an outline
review.name: Revision notes
review.text: Turn my slides and notes into a revision outline with key points and worked examples. Show me the structure first, and write it in full once I confirm. The course is:

group.label: Split up group work
group.name: Group assignment
group.text: Break our group assignment into tasks we can act on, with a suggested split and a schedule. Show me how you would break it down first. The assignment is:

assignment.label: Set an assignment
assignment.name: Assignment design
assignment.text: Design an assignment for me with the task, submission requirements and a grading rubric. Show me the idea first, and write it in full once I confirm. The course and topic are:

slides.label: Organise course materials
slides.name: Course handout
slides.text: Turn my material into a handout with key points and worked examples per section. Show me the structure first, and write it in full once I confirm. The lesson is about:

feedback.label: Draft feedback on work
feedback.name: Assignment feedback
feedback.text: Draft feedback on the submissions against the rubric. Show me how you plan to grade first, and write each one once I confirm. The rubric is:

course.label: Catalogue course materials
course.name: Course materials
course.text: Organise the course materials into a catalogue with one line on each. Show me the categories first, and organise them once I confirm. The course is:

doc.label: Write a document or notice
doc.name: Work document
doc.text: Write a document for me. Show me the outline first, and write it in full once I confirm. What I need is:

table.label: Clean up spreadsheet data
table.name: Data cleanup
table.text: Clean up the spreadsheet and sum it up clearly. Tell me how you plan to handle it first, and start once I confirm. What I need is:

tool.label: Build a small tool
tool.name: Small tool
tool.text: Build a small web tool for me and give me a preview I can open when it is done. Show me the page structure first, and start once I confirm. It should:

plan.label: Plan a project and split the work
plan.name: Project plan
plan.text: Break this into tasks we can act on, with a suggested split of the work and a schedule. Show me how you would break it down first. The work is:

survey.label: Literature review
survey.name: Literature review
survey.text: Find the relevant literature, cite your sources, and write it up as a survey. Show me the outline first, and write it in full once I confirm. The research question is:

data.label: Analyse data
data.name: Data analysis
data.text: Analyse the data and give me the statistics and plots. Tell me how you plan to analyse it first, and start once I confirm. What I want to know is:

section.label: Write a section of a paper
section.name: Paper writing
section.text: Write a section of my paper. Show me the outline first, and write it in full once I confirm. The section is:

reproduce.label: Reproduce some code
reproduce.hint: Get a paper or repo running
reproduce.name: Reproduction
reproduce.text: Reproduce some code for me and tell me the results once it runs. Show me how you plan to do it first, and start once I confirm. What to reproduce:

tidy.label: Tidy up or rewrite a document
tidy.name: Document cleanup
tidy.text: Tidy up or rewrite my material. Show me how you plan to change it first, and start once I confirm. What I want is:

research.label: Research a topic into a report
research.name: Research
research.text: Look up the material for me, cite your sources, and write it up as a report. Show me the outline first, and write it in full once I confirm. What I want to understand is:

build.label: Build a web page or small tool
build.hint: Open the preview when it is done
build.name: Small tool
build.text: Build a web page for me and give me a preview I can open when it is done. Show me the page structure first, and start once I confirm. What I want to build is:

plan.label: Break down a goal and split the work
plan.name: Project plan
plan.text: Break my goal into tasks I can act on, with a suggested split of the work and a schedule. Show me how you would break it down first. My goal is:

preview.title: Your project
preview.hint: Each answer adds to this card. The project is made when you click Create project.

tour.auto: Moves on once you do it

send.title: Hand off to {agent}
send.text: Your first request is already in the box, starting with {'@'}{agent}. Fill in the rest and send it from here.

reply.title: {agent}'s reply
reply.text: {agent} has replied, in a thread under your message. Open it.
reply.textWaiting: The reply is in a thread under your message; open it. If it is still being written, you can leave and will be notified.
reply.textFailed: {agent} could not reply this time; the thread says why. Open it, and once that is sorted, press Retry.

confirm.title: Confirm in the thread
confirm.text: {agent} shows you a plan first. Reply in this thread (for example "Looks good, go ahead") and it starts; ask for changes the same way.
confirm.textWaiting: Open the thread under your message to read {agent}'s plan.

task.title: Task
task.text: {agent} turned this thread into a task. Open it to follow progress and changes.
task.textWaiting: This thread becomes a task listed under your message: open it to follow progress and changes.

taskPage.title: Task page
taskPage.text: Progress, changes and the delivery are all on the task page. When it is done {agent} hands the result to you to review.
taskPage.textWaiting: Open the task {agent} created; progress and the delivery are inside.

accept.title: Accept
accept.text: {agent} has delivered. Look at the result: accept it to add it to the project, or send it back with a reason.
accept.textWaiting: The review card appears here: accept the result, or send it back with a reason. You can leave while it is still working and will be notified.

overview.title: Overview
overview.text: Accepted results show up here: a new version of the project under What was made, and the acceptance under Recent progress.
overview.textWaiting: Accepted results are on the Overview in the sidebar: What was made gains a new version of the project.
